title: The Last Letters
author: Vesper Quintana
blurb: Xanthe Almeida, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
